question: A study conducted by scientists at the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) in March 2023 found that certain areas in ______ are experiencing nearly three times more background radiation than previously assumed.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A pan-India study** conducted by scientists at the **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)** found that the background radiation levels in certain parts of **Kerala** are almost **three times** higher than previously estimated.
 
• The study found that the levels of background radiation in the **Kollam district** (where Chavara is situated) were **9,562 nGy/hr**, or about three times more.
 
• The higher radiation levels in Kollam are attributed to **monazite sands** that are high in thorium.
 
• Southern India has higher levels of radiation from** uranium deposits **due to the presence of **granite and basaltic volcanic rock**.
 
• Despite the higher levels in Kollam, there have not been any significant findings of increased cancer rates or mortality, suggesting that the **radiation levels may not be harmful to human health****.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC):**

 
 
• The **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)** is considered India's premier **nuclear research facility,** with its **headquarters** located in **Trombay, Mumbai, Maharashtra.**
 
• The centre was established by** Homi Jehangir Bhabha Atomic Energy Establishment in Trombay (AEET) **as a multidisciplinary research program essential for India's nuclear program, operating under the **Department of Atomic Energy (DAE)**.
 
• BARC plays a crucial role in India's **civilian and military nuclear programs,** including the design and manufacture of nuclear reactors and the development and production of nuclear fuels.
 
• This research and development centre focuses on the advancement of **nuclear science, nuclear power production, and the use of radioisotopes **in **industry, health, and agriculture**.
 
• Initial reactors at BARC and its affiliated power generation centres were** imported from the west**, more specifically, India's first power reactors installed at the **Tarapur Atomic Power Station** were from the** United States**. However, over time India has developed its indigenous nuclear technology.
